dogecoin.text:
IoT Chain and Dogecoin China community reached a strategic cooperation.
https://t.co/xDkgBKO7bY

#IoTChain #Dogecoin

The Doge China community aims to continue to help and promote Dogecoin’s advancement and promotion in China, their goal is to reach a consensus with the global technical community and continue to update and maintain Dogecoin’s technical code.

The Doge China is a newly launched community which is jointly initiated by exchanges, funds, media, activists, blockchain project parties, mining pools, quantitative institutions, and the Dogecoin consensus users.
@dogecoin We are not cooperating with the community organization represented by @dogecoin , we are cooperating with“ 狗狗中国社区Dogechina”, a Chinese Dogecoin Community.
